text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s02","problem":"Both card cover images are flat placeholder art (beige tower, dark skyline). The real screen shows a detailed painted fantasy town on the left and a night city skyline on the right. This is the biggest red area on the heatmap and was asked for last round without improvement.","fix":"No card-art asset is listed for s02, so redraw the covers closer to the real ones. Left card (x 17-199, y 332-513): warm sky, market stalls with red bunting at the top, colorful buildings, a domed tower, a dark armored figure at bottom right. Right card (x 218-394, y 332-513): dark blue-black night sky with dense skyscrapers lit by many small warm windows, filling the full width with no gray band. Match the average colors."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The bottom nav center icon is a cat face. The real one is a purple/white spiral logo. It was asked for before and is still wrong.","fix":"Draw the center icon as a spiral swirl in #d9d0f0 with a rounded stroke, about 26px, centered at x=205, y=805. Remove the cat ears and face."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The filter chip emojis (Male, Dominant, Female) and the emoji in the Anime tag render differently from the real ones. The real chip text sits about 1px lower, and the chip row is slightly heavier.","fix":"Use the colorful emoji glyphs: 👨 for Male, ⛓️ for Dominant, 👩‍🦰 for Female, 📚 for Fictional, 📺 for Anime. Keep the 12px chip text, weight 500, and shift it down 1px."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The avatar is a cartoon bucket on a dark tile. The real one is a shiba inu head in a teal bucket with a mop. No asset is listed, so it has to be approximated.","fix":"Redraw the avatar at x 17-93, y 56-132: a dark gray background, an orange and white shiba face at the top center, a teal bucket with a white 'Janitor AI' label, and a blue mop on the right. Fill the tile."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The 'No characters found' text is slightly too large and heavy, and the tab icons and the bottom nav cat icon are offset from the real ones.","fix":"Reduce the 'No characters found' font to 16px, weight 600, centered at y=393. Replace the center nav icon with the spiral logo. Shift the tab icons about 1px."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The creator avatar is a blue vertical-stripe gradient. The real one is a dark blue-teal misty alley scene (x 28-147, y 75-194). The Hot Day card image also shows a different crop of the character.","fix":"Redraw the avatar with a dark navy top, a lighter cyan-blue fog glow in the center, and dark building silhouettes at the left and right edges, with no stripes. For the Hot Day image, use a light gray background with white spiky hair at the top and a dark blindfold at about y=790, shifted so the hair spikes start near y=722."},{"element_id":"s07","problem":"The FOLLOW and share buttons and the 'Options' label look different. The share button is a flatter yellow, where the real one is a richer gold gradient with a white icon and text. The text is bolder in the mock.","fix":"Give the share button a gold gradient (#e8b93a to #b8860b) with white 'share' text at weight 500, and reduce the Options text weight to 500. Keep the FOLLOW outline gold with text #e8b93a."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The Sort by option labels and the Messages/Tokens dropdown text sit 1px too high and look bolder than the real ones. The real text is lighter.","fix":"Shift the option labels and the dropdown text down 1px, and set the weight to 400 for the labels and 500 for the dropdown values."}],"summary":"All tagged elements and taps are already correct. The remaining loss is visual: the card cover art on s02, the avatars on s05 and s07, and the spiral nav logo. This round should redraw the s02 cover art and the spiral icon, and fix the avatars, since the mock has no picture assets for those."}
